text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, I stopped by a shop with Agnes Digital,
who said she needed to pick up a preordered item.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume photobook I've been waiting for so long...
Hehehe, the moment I get home, it's unboxing time!
choice_data_list: That was pretty thick, wasn't it?
That was pretty thick, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I bought three copies, after all.
One for viewing, one for preservation, and one to carry around!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Each book comes with an entry ticket for the release event, you see.
So if you buy three copies, your chances of winning triple—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Digital-san?
No way, what a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, hello~!!
Long time no see since the meet-and-greet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A woman called out to me inside the shop.
She was likely a fellow Umamusume fan
and friend of Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital-san, sorry for the sudden question,
but do you have some time after this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is it time? Um...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to go to a concert now, but the friend
I was planning to go with couldn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want an empty seat, so
I was looking for someone who could go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Starting now today, you mean... C-could it be,
the secret live show included on the bonus disc!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You mean the "Phantom Secret" that even I couldn't pull after buying stacks of discs!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To THAT super-duper-ultra-exclusive live concert
I desperately convinced myself didn't exist to give up on it?!
You, my god, are inviting me to it?!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! There are two tickets,
so please, take someone along with you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad to go!
Thaaank you sooo muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, thank goodness!
I know Digital-san will definitely liven things up!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll hype it up with everything I've got!!
I brought penlights and everything!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Do you have someone coming with you?
Bringing cheering goods is permitted this time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told them I didn't have any penlights or anything,
the two of them offered to lend me some cheering goods.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which do you prefer, a penlight or a handheld fan?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll lend you my penlight later!
Now, onward to the amusement park's special stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ngaaah, a wink! I'm dead, that totally killed me!
That fan service bombardment is ruthless!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what is this!?
Could it be a new song!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In time with the song, the penlights all change color in unison.
I scramble to match the surrounding glow,
but in my flustered rush, I can't seem to find the right color.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
There's a mode that cycles through colors automatically.
Just long-press the right button!
choice_data_list: But the color's different, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's no set way to enjoy it!
As long as you're mindful of the rules and manners, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just pick your favorite color and wave it to the beat!
choice_data_list: Then I'll just give it a random shake!
Then I'll just give it a random shake, okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please enjoy it to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nhaaahhh~~~~~...
So amazing... Truly the best of the best...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that during the first song!? The way their hands caressed it!!
Aaah, I wanna be that mic stand so baaad~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The intense choreography for the new song is super lit too!!
Those powerful steps are so totally horse-girl-esque, the choreographer seriously gets it~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's timing on clicking their heels was so perfect!
Bonds! I really felt our bonds right there!!
choice_data_list: Waving our lights together was fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right!!
Shaking it with that 'thump-thump' feels so good, doesn't it?!
choice_data_list: It felt like the whole venue became one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's exactly it!
That sense of unity when call-and-responses and penlights sync up perfectly!
That's the true thrill of a live performance!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's so great being able to share our thoughts like this!
I usually attend solo, so I'm always just screaming into the void on Umatter~
choice_data_list: This time is really enjoyable, too.
Times like this are fun too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer!? In that case...
I know! I'll apply for two spots at the release event for the photobook I bought today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If we win, let's go together!
And talk all about it! ...Deal!?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this fan my friend was going to use!
Well then, shall we head over to the amusement park venue?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
More! Steal their hearts!
Send it to 'em! Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Call and response echoed across the special venue.
The energy of the concert reached its fever pitch.
Agnes Digital was going wild too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...With that, the Umamusume on stage
began walking over toward us while singing."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the fan!!
Please show the fan to that Umamusume-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Prompted by her words, I readjusted the uchiwa fan so the lettering would be visible from the stage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eeek-gyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I saw it... The horseshoe spinning around...
Haa, haa... The leg... The way she lifted her leg was so cute...
And the fluttering skirt is just the best...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nhaaahhh~~~~!
An angel has descended upon us~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Thanks a buuunch for catching the stray fan service shot!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's the fan, the uchiwa fan!
Thanks to you holding it up, Trainer,
I got showered with fan service too!"
choice_data_list: True, the fan service was nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my message, my favorite idol on stage
reacted to it. It was only for a split second,
but I truly felt a connection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right? Aside from the fan service,
the live concert vibe itself is totally addictive,
and it makes you just want to keep coming back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, looks like you've fallen under the
live show's spell too, Trainer!
Welcome to the rabbit hole☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that reminds me. I'll sign us both up
for the release event of the photobook we bought today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to another concert together!
And sink into the deep end together! ...Right?!
